author: Quillshot
description: Image generation with Google Gemini. Chat is handled by the Claude cog, which hands image requests to this cog.
install_msg:
Thank you for installing! 

1. Get API key: https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey
2. Run `[p]gemini setkey <key>`.
3. Try `[p]draw a castle at sunset`.
end_user_data_statement: Stores User IDs for image model preferences. Image sessions are in RAM only.
